question: When did the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 come into effect ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**January 2020**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Parliament passed the Transgender person (protection of right **)Bill,2019 on 26 Nov 2019**
 
• It defines a transgender person whose gender does** not match the gender assigned at birth**
 
• It provides every transgender person with the right to live an equal
 
• The Bill | States that transgender persons will have the right to **“self-perceived” gender identity**
 
• The Bill | Enforces a minor’s right of residence compelling any transperson below 18 to cohabit with their natal family.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Bill, 2019 was introduced in** Lok Sabha on July 19, 2019.**
 
• The Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment, Mr** Thaawarchand Gehlot introduced the bill.**
 
• **Japan **was the** first country** to legalise transgender people in **July 2003.**
 
• **Christine Jorgensen (USA**) was the first transgender in the world, in** 1954.**
 
• **Naaz Joshi **is the first transgender in** India**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **In our constitution to Article 79 (part-v) mention BILL,ACT**

 
 

 **ACT**
 **BILL**
 
 

 
 
an act is a law passed by the parliament

 
 Bill is the draft of a proposed law that is presented to the parliament
 
 

 An act is called a bill before the parliament approves it
 Bill becomes an act after it is approved by the parliament
